top_categories.workout_context: Road-specific control matters at Granfondo Tre Valli Varesine. Practice on hilly pre-alpine terrain with significant: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 78 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Granfondo Tre Valli Varesine's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before October.
84ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
6,539ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
At Granfondo Tre Valli Varesine, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Granfondo Tre Valli Varesine. Train it until it feels boring.
78 miles on hilly pre-alpine terrain with significant burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.

Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Granfondo Tre Valli Varesine. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.

race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for Granfondo Tre Valli Varesine's 78 miles. Start early, use products you tolerate, and carry enough between the organizer’s confirmed resupply points.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at Granfondo Tre Valli Varesine. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The technical descents at Granfondo Tre Valli Varesine demand practice on similar paved roads. Ride hilly pre-alpine terrain with significant climbing on fully paved roads at race-day cadence weekly. Practice braking points, corner entry, line choice, and accelerating smoothly out of turns. Confirm tire pressure and equipment before race week.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Road Specific, Race Simulation, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 78 miles of hilly pre-alpine terrain with significant climbing on fully paved roads in Varese, Lombardy, Italy.
